patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents with a complaint of severe vulvar itching that has been gradually worsening over the course of the past year. She has attempted to use over-the-counter lubricants for relief with no substantial improvement. She reports severe pain during vaginal intercourse that has recently led to cessation of sexual activity.

Secondary_Symptoms: Use of over-the-counter lubricants with no relief

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Diet-controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension treated with hydrochlorothiazide, menopause occurred at 52 years of age.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Sexually active with her husband until recently due to discomfort.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies urinary symptoms, abnormal vaginal discharge, or rectal symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with chronic vulvar itching and discomfort.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’m a 60-year-old woman, and over the past year my vulvar itching has gradually become very severe. I’ve tried over-the-counter lubricants, but they haven’t helped much, and intercourse has become so painful that I’ve stopped having sex.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints, and I don’t have joint pain that’s been concerning.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. It’s mainly been persistent severe itching and irritation in the vulvar area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “Mostly it’s been focused on my vulvar area with severe itching, but I haven’t noticed the same level of itching elsewhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have trouble lifting my arms above my head, and I haven’t noticed any muscle weakness or trouble with my range of motion.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision or changes like that. My main issue has been the persistent, severe vulvar itching and irritation, along with painful intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s been so high it feels like you’re burning up—something above 104°F (40°C) that makes you feel extremely hot or dizzy?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any fever like that—no episodes where I felt extremely hot, dizzy, or burning up.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually stressed or overwhelmed—this has mainly been steadily worsening vulvar itching and irritation over the past year, with pain during intercourse that’s made me stop.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any burning or discomfort when I urinate. It’s really been concentrated on the vulvar area—severe itching and irritation—along with pain during intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any chills or feverish feelings. It’s mainly been persistent severe vulvar itching and irritation, and the pain during intercourse has gradually gotten worse over the past year.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump in your breast that feels firm and hasn’t moved?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps in my breast—nothing firm that feels fixed or unmoving. My concerns have been limited to the persistent severe vulvar itching and irritation, and the pain during intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you feeling any pain or discomfort on the sides of your abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had pain or discomfort on the sides of my abdomen between my ribs and hips. My discomfort is mainly focused on the vulvar area—persistent severe itching and irritation, and pain during intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does that pain go away when you stop walking?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any pain in my calves when I walk, and it doesn’t happen when I stop walking—my discomfort has been mainly in the vulvar area with severe itching and irritation, plus pain during intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your urine looks darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in the color of my urine—it hasn’t looked darker than usual. My main problem is still the severe vulvar itching and irritation, and the pain during intercourse that’s been steadily getting worse over the past year.”
